title: Rain Between the Walls
statement:
A line of walls stands on flat ground; wall `i` has height `h_i` and every wall is one unit wide with no gaps between walls. After heavy rain, water collects in the dips: the water above wall `i` rises to the smaller of the tallest wall on its left and the tallest wall on its right (counting wall `i` itself), and stays only if that is higher than the wall. Find the total volume of water, counting one unit of volume per unit of height above each wall.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `n` integers, the heights.

## Output
Print the total volume of trapped water. The answer can be larger than 32 bits.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 100000`
- `0 <= h_i <= 10^9`
